review.rationale: The Decision binds exactly to the cited Recommendation and its qwen review (refs + SHA-256 + commit + remote_verified=true). Artifact-addressed identity is sound: release_id combines source_commit and archive SHA-256 with a strict pattern, source_revision-only identity is explicitly rejected, and future_release_path_creation_authorized=false. The single-SSH sequence (D03–D09) is strictly read-only (symlink target, release metadata, rollback presence/mode, releases-root/current-parent modes, filesystem capacity, nginx/static-root prerequisites) and sufficient for preflight; D10 limits Git activity to committing/pushing only the two preflight artifacts. Caps enforce zero writes, zero deployments/releases/rollbacks/repairs, zero archive transfers/extractions, zero chmod/chown/symlink/nginx operations, one SSH session, and bounded reads. Historical observation is explicitly not treated as current truth (treated_as_current_truth=false, authorization_inferred=false). Deployment remains separately unauthorized (deployment_authorized=false, release_authorized=false, later_separate_execution_required=true, execution_started=false). Minor note: candidate_contract.deployment_admission_pass=false is consistent with preflight-only status and does not invalidate the read-only admission preflight authorization.
